user.title: Add anniversary
user.description: Create an anniversary sensor. Each entry creates one sensor.

data_description.name: Sensor name, for example: Wedding anniversary.
data_description.year: Type the year directly, for example 2050. Range 1900-2100. In lunar mode it is the lunar year.
data_description.day: Select the day. In lunar mode it is the lunar day; a missing 30th day falls back to the last day of that month.
data_description.calendar: Whether the date is solar or lunar.
data_description.display_mode: Absolute always shows a positive number. Signed can show negative numbers after the date has passed.
data_description.style: Year-month-day and Year-month-day-hour-minute-second are text; Day is numeric. Leading zeros are omitted.
data_description.period: None: count down to a fixed date. Year: repeats every year. Month: repeats every month.
data_description.is_leap_month: Lunar only. Use the leap month when it exists; otherwise fall back to the regular month.
data_description.update_interval: How often the sensor recalculates, in seconds. Default 3600.

error.invalid_date: Invalid date. Check year/month/day for solar, or month/day for lunar.
error.invalid_interval: Update interval must be between 1 and 86400 seconds.
